title: Semantic Knowledge Technologies: what the Semantic Web lost sight of, and what it never had
abstract: arXiv:2609.14121v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Semantic Web set out to give information a machine-interpretable form so that software could integrate and reason over it. Its standards became scientific knowledge infrastructure, but the machine competence it promised did not follow, and the systems now answering questions over scientific knowledge are language models holding no inspectable account of what they know. This paper argues the original goal was right and the technical programme incomplete, states what is missing, and names the extended programme Semantic Knowledge Technologies: the same technical core carried out of its web-publishing origin and applied to knowledge wherever held. The diagnosis is that the standards formalised truth while omitting three things: the conditions under which a claim holds, the operations its terms permit, and any account of what a base covers. Without conditions, contradiction and applicability cannot be judged; without operational groundin

translated_title: 语义知识技术：语义网络所遗失的，以及它从未拥有过的
translated_abstract: 语义网络的目标是赋予信息一种机器可解释的形式，使软件能够集成信息并对其进行推理。它的标准已成为科学知识基础设施，但它所承诺的机器能力并未随之实现，如今回答科学知识问题的系统是语言模型，而语言模型对其所知的内容并没有任何可检验的说明。本文认为最初的目标是正确的，而技术方案是不完整的，指出了缺失的内容，并将扩展后的方案命名为语义知识技术：即让同样的技术核心走出其网络发布的起源，应用于知识所存在的一切地方。本文的诊断是：这些标准将真理形式化，却遗漏了三件事——一个断言成立的条件、其术语所允许的操作，以及对知识库覆盖范围的任何说明。没有条件，就无法判断矛盾与适用性；没有操作基础……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文指出语义网络的最初目标正确但技术方案不完整——其标准遗漏了断言成立的条件、术语所允许的操作和知识库覆盖范围三项关键要素，因而提出将技术核心扩展到网络发布之外一切知识领域的“语义知识技术”。
en_tdlr: The paper argues the Semantic Web's original goal was right but its technical programme incomplete—omitting conditions under which claims hold, permitted operations of terms, and accounts of knowledge-base coverage—and proposes "Semantic Knowledge Technologies" to extend its core beyond web publishing to knowledge wherever held.
